quest.title: Blazin' Trails
quest.description: Following the result of Mona's divination, the party heads to another island. There, you see a strangely shaped plant which looks like... some kind of musical instrument?
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Get up, lazybones! The sun's so high, it's right in your eyes!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon, it's fine, I sleep with my eyes closed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's why you couldn't see that the sun's in your eyes!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: #I trust you slept well, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Sounds like the same story for everyone. I got up first today, so I took a walk around and picked some fruits for our breakfast.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And Paimon's been waiting for you to get up so she can finally dig in!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You all enjoy breakfast together and get chatting...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Fischl left first thing in the morning?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Yeah, she seemed unwilling to stay with us. She said she had some other work to do for the Adventurers' Guild.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A likely story! What happened to coming here to restore the glory of the Immernachtreich? Now she has Guild work to do all of a sudden?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright, Paimon, keep it together...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Judging by that look on her face... there was probably something on her mind.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: We tried sending Mona to comfort her, like before... but she said Mona doesn't understand the work of the Adventurers' Guild, and can't go with her.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She didn't even make up some excuse about the Immernachtreich to get some time alone? That's out of character for her.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Then she must be feeling quite troubled.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: I'd love to help her as a friend... but she was right about one thing. We're going to explore another island today.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Oh? Is that so?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup, votes are in, it's unanimous!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But I wasn't there for the vote!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Oh, yeah, about that... Paimon went ahead and voted for you. She said since you're always together, her opinion counts as yours, and vice versa.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, well, you are an adventurer, after all. Paimon knew you'd wanna go exploring!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Aah, Paimon... well, guess it's happening now...)

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Fischl said there's something she wants to investigate, and suggested that we all go ahead in the meantime. She told me not to worry, she'll catch up with us when she's done.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Despite her... quirks, she's still an experienced adventurer. I think we should trust her.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I haven't known her for long, so this is just an observation, but... it seems like she's struggling with some internal conflict.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, that seems about right...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: In conflict with others, you either resolve it or let it be. But when the conflict is within yourself, it's much harder to do either.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: ...I've also had a time like that in my life, so I understand what she's going through. It may be best to give her some space.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: I agree. Still, it's a pity for today's adventure. Adventuring is always more fun when everyone's together.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Xinyan always has great team spirit...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: #Oh, one other thing. This morning, we saw a mirage on the island in the north. We can go take a look once you're done with your breakfast, {NICKNAME}.

talks.objective: Head to the island in the north

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This island looks pretty normal.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: ...I smell something burning on the wind.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Ugh... my scryglass is getting clearer, but I still can't see much...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Hey, look what I found!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: It's a... well, is it a drum, or a plant?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: An instrument made of a plant? Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Xinyan, do you think this could be your island?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Oh, you mean this instrument could have been put here just for me? Okay, let me give it a try...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hold on. When I touched the rock garden in the bonsai yesterday, we were all transported to another space. Xinyan, do you want to take some time first to get ready?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: You're right, but it's all good. I'm always ready to make some music!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *cough* *cough* Paimon just got a mouthful of dirt...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Paimon, are you okay?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Just as we thought... we've been sent to another place.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Why does this place feel so bleak? ...Xinyan, are you sure this is your mirage?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: I think so, yeah, but... you're right, why is it so bleak here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look, there's something really bright over there. It's almost like it's inviting us to go check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Okay, let's go have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, wait, wait! This is too obvious. Surely it's gotta be a trap?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: That may well be, but there's also nowhere else for us to go.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Indeed...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: If this mirage belongs to Xinyan, I don't think we will find any traps there.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Now you're talking! You know that wouldn't be my style.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, that makes sense. Alright, let's go then, but let's also make sure to be careful.

talks.objective: Go to the brightly lit place

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: The door is locked.

choices.text: Mona, do that thing where you turn into water, and slide under!

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Keep your nonsense to yourself, thank you very much.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Xinyan, why did you lock the door?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: You'd think I'd know this... Haha...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Oh, actually... I usually put my key under the flower pot next to the door. So... maybe the key is nearby.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Is there a flower pot around here?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: There are no pots, but there is... a flower.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: I guess it's worth a shot.

choices.text: Kazuha, lift yourself into the air and jump over it!

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: ...Let's keep thinking this through.

talks.objective: Open the door using the key

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, that flower is huuuge!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: It's so hot here... is it because of that flower?

dialogues.speaker: Blazing Heart
dialogues.text: Heck yeah, I wasn't expecting visitors.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aaaah!!! It talks!

choices.text: So did the squirrel from yesterday.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon knows! But this is different!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Hi, we touched those drum-like plants growing on the beach outside, and were transported here. Are you the owner of this place?

response.speaker: Blazing Heart
response.text: This is the hall of music, and I'm merely its gatekeeper. Tell me, my friends, are you here to pursue the ultimate expression of music?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Ohh, you betcha!

response.speaker: Blazing Heart
response.text: Then tell me, what do you hope to express with music?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: The spirit of resistance!

response.speaker: Blazing Heart
response.text: Right on, great answer! I'm so glad to hear that. I consider myself very lucky to meet another musician with the same ideals.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Even giant flowers get along well with Xinyan...

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: People who are easy to get along with make friends wherever they go.

response.speaker: Blazing Heart
response.text: If you've made it this far, you must wish to venture deeper into the hall of music. However, I must apologize. My singing voice is required for entry, but unfortunately my pipes are a little dry...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Are you alright? Do you need... uh, some cold medicine or something?

response.speaker: Blazing Heart
response.text: It's just that I haven't had any Glacial Spring Water in a very long time. If I could drink some of that, my voice would be rocked and loaded, and ready to clear your path.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Glacial Spring Water?

response.speaker: Blazing Heart
response.text: Yeah. With one sip of that, anyone could sing the most beautiful song, no matter if they were a weary adult, a sleepy bird, or even an ignorant child...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Okay, I'll find some for ya. Where is this spring?

response.speaker: Blazing Heart
response.text: Thanks, you're the best! Well, spring water helps plants grow up strong so that they can scale the mountains that lie in their way... so, I imagine the spring can be found somewhere on the mountain range protected by plants.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You mean we have to go hiking? Oh, Paimon thought some seawater would be enough.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Spring water and seawater could not be more dissimilar.

response.speaker: Blazing Heart
response.text: Oh, but you may need my powers in order to see the spring. Give me your hand, friend, so that you can see through my eyes.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Thanks! You shook my hand — guess that makes this friendship official!

choices.text: So did the boat from yesterday.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, we're out!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: It's much brighter here. I didn't mind that hot cave, though.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Glacial Spring Water can be found on one of the mountains around here. Let's all look for it.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Wait, how can there be light coming from below the ground here? Is this... a water vein?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: According to that flower, the water vein is related to the plants, and the plants will lead us to that spring. So I guess we should follow the water veins.

talks.objective: Clear the water veins that flow through the mountains

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Everyone, I found a note here.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Oh, so that's how it is. What an interesting island.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look at this style and signature... it's from Albedo! He's one of our friends from Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He's an amazing alchemist who's visited this island before. He left this note here for future adventurers.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Oh? So it's him.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: He's saying this whole island has been turned into an instrument!? Amazing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And the underground water veins play an important part too... Oh, maybe we need to clear all the water veins to "play" this island.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Clean your instrument before the performance! Makes a lot of sense.

talks.objective: Clear the water veins that flow through the mountains

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This should be the Glacial Spring Water we're looking for.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: So if you drink this, you can suddenly sing like an angel?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: You should give it a try, if you're curious.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: No no no, I'm terrible at singing... it would be extremely embarrassing if it didn't work.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Haha, Mona, I actually think you've got a sweet voice that's well-suited for singing! If you're interested, I can teach you a few things about vocals once we get back to camp.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Really? I—I'd love to, but you'd have to promise you won't laugh at me.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Of course not! Everyone's gotta start somewhere, right?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: R—Right... then maybe I can give it a try.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Great! But before that, we should deliver the spring water to that flower.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Well, to re-enter the mirage, we just need to touch the drum on the beach again.
